meta.name: pin-wrap-up
meta.description: Use at the end of a work session to review the WHOLE session and record entities worth pinning. This is the manual, deliberate complete-sweep review — NOT an automated nudge. Triggers on "wrap up", "wrap-up", "session wrap", "end of session", "what should I pin".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回顾工作会话，记录重要信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次工作结束都需要理清重点
copy.tagline_en: Review work sessions and record important entities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to capture key points after each session.

howto.what: 在工作会话结束时，Claude会手动回顾整个会话，识别并列出值得记录的实体（如外部资源、决定、架构事实等），让用户确认后通过脚本记录固定。
howto.when: 当用户在工作会话结束时说出“wrap up”、“wrap-up”、“session wrap”、“end of session”或“what should I pin”时触发。

say.text: 整理一下这次会话，看看有什么值得固定的。
say.note: Claude会扫描整个会话并列出候选实体。

say.text: 帮我回顾一下会话，记录要点。
say.note: Claude会应用固定标准筛选候选实体。

say.text: 这次会话中，有哪些需要固定记录的知识点？
say.note: Claude会列出候选实体并等待确认。

howto.what_en: At the end of a work session, Claude manually reviews the entire session, identifies entities worth pinning (e.g., external sources, decisions, architecture facts), shows them for confirmation, and records them via a script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says “wrap up”, “wrap-up”, “session wrap”, “end of session”, or “what should I pin” at the end of a work session.

say_en.text: Wrap up this session and capture what matters.
say_en.note: Claude scans the session and lists candidate entities.

say_en.text: Review the session and record key points.
say_en.note: Claude applies pin-worthiness criteria to filter candidates.

say_en.text: Which knowledge from this session should be pinned?
say_en.note: Claude proposes candidates for the user to confirm.
